AN OUTSTANDING ADDRESS - PRESENTING THIS SUPERB FOUR BEDROOM DETACHED FAMILY HOME

Davis Auctioneers take great pleasure in bringing to the market, this neatly presented detached family home, just a few hundred meters from the centre of Drumlish Village. Glasheen is a hugely sought after residential address within the county, a unique development, consisting entirely of detached family homes. No. 2, which is one of only four houses, that sit outside the development along the Newtownforbes Road, is a block-built construction, providing an impressive building energy rating of B. This impressive 1,650 sq. ft. four-bedroom property has the option of a work from home office (4th bedroom) on the ground floor also.

The well-appointed accommodation consists of a light filled entrance hall with elongated window, sitting room, kitchen/dining room, bedroom/office, utility, and WC on the ground floor. On the first floor there are three tastefully decorated bedrooms, two of which are ensuite, one with walk-in wardrobe, as well as a large family bathroom. The property, which possesses energy efficient solar panels, comes complete with a solid fuel stove in the sitting room.

Drumlish is just a few miles off the N4 national route, as well as being within one hour of Sligo and less than 90 minutes to Dublin City. A daily commute to the Capital is quite common with some villagers. The ever-expanding village has two fine supermarkets, a service station, library, pharmacy, community sports centre and post office. Young families are well catered for with ample childcare and pre-school facilities. The local national school is just a 10-minute walk from Glasheen. Post primary schools are located at Moyne, Mohill and Longford Town, all within a 15-minute drive. 

Viewing of No. 2 Glasheen is highly recommended by the sole Auctioneers.

Please call to us at 53 Main Street, Longford, or contact us on 043 33 50555 to arrange your viewing.

EIRCODE: N39 KT78

Folio: LD15980F
